description: Curated authority map. Each entry names where a concept's source of truth lives. `consumers` / `tests` are derived by `dev map` (generated into .dev/project-map.json) — do not hand-maintain them here. `dev authority --check` verifies every listed path exists.

authorities.title: Branded ID types
mutation: src/domain/ids.ts (as* converters; validation happens at content/save boundaries)
authorities.notes: IDs are runtime strings; the brand only exists at compile time. Conversion is unchecked by design — boundary validation is in content schema and save schema.

authorities.title: Randomness
authorities.notes: All game randomness must flow through RandomSource. Same seed => same sequence; simulations rely on this for determinism.

authorities.title: Fish species identity and stats
authorities.persisted: content (identity); species ids referenced by save.codex / save.knowledge
authorities.notes: Since save v8 species ids are canonical world-wide ids (not region-scoped). Renaming an id breaks saved codex/knowledge keys.

authorities.title: Generated fish individual (size/weight/condition/traits)
authorities.persisted: save.trade.fishBox (landed fish only); encounter-time individuals are ephemeral
authorities.notes: Species selection (encounter) and individual generation are separate authorities — see DATA_MODEL.md §8.

authorities.title: Fishing spot identity and properties
authorities.notes: Spot requires capabilities, not angler level (ARCHITECTURE.md §5). Hidden spots gate on discovery (save.world.discoveredSpotIds).

authorities.title: Fishing zone inside a spot
authorities.persisted: content (inside fishing-spots records); zone ids referenced transiently by catch results
authorities.notes: Zones do not hard-gate species; FishOccurrence.zoneAffinity weights them. A zone without castDistanceM models vertical water (under boat).

authorities.title: Zone where the offering actually landed
authorities.notes: WARNING: this authority currently lives in the UI layer (useFishingSession). Encounter weighting, abrasion risk and Catch Result must all read the same landed zone — including drift cases where selected != landed. Contract test locks this; do not fork a second resolver.

authorities.title: Species selection / encounter weighting
authorities.notes: Chooses species candidate only; individual generation is generateFishIndividual. Weighting uses FishOccurrence.basePresence + zone affinity + environment.

authorities.title: Catch result assembly
authorities.persisted: derived — codex records + fishBox entries written from it
authorities.notes: Must reference a valid species and the actual landed zone.

authorities.title: Fight state machine (hooked -> landed/escape)
authorities.notes: UI sends commands + ticks only; UI never decides outcomes. Time unit is ticks, not ms.

authorities.title: Gear stats (rod/reel/line/hook/lure/bait)
authorities.persisted: content (definitions); save.inventory holds owned gear ids/instances
authorities.notes: Real-world attributes and game tuning values are separated (DATA_MODEL.md §13).

authorities.title: Equipped tackle validity
authorities.notes: Impossible combinations must be rejected at the domain layer, not the UI.

authorities.title: Angler level / XP / skills / perks
authorities.notes: XP sources are codified (first catch bonus, personal record bonus) — codex must persist or bonuses re-trigger (see SaveGame v2 comment). Level is derived from total XP via AnglerLevel.

authorities.title: Player knowledge (spots/regions/species)
authorities.notes: Knowledge gates information quality (what is shown), not capability. Grows via trips/discovery.

authorities.title: Catch records / personal records
authorities.notes: Persisted to prevent first-catch / record XP re-farming. Keys are canonical species ids (v8+).

authorities.title: Access requirements / why a spot is unreachable
authorities.notes: AccessEngine knows capabilities, not concrete product ids. Money shortage is Economy's verdict, not Access. One travel option must satisfy all required capabilities — no synthesizing routes across vehicles.

authorities.title: Travel option resolution and trip movement
authorities.notes: Trip UI lists ResolvedTravelOptions; cheapest is default. UI must not reimplement access/cost rules.

authorities.title: Money / finance / settlement
authorities.notes: Monthly settlement state and history persist since v4. Balance judgments are out of scope for validators.

authorities.title: In-game time and calendar
authorities.notes: Domain never reads wall-clock; app passes now().

authorities.title: Trip state machine (HOME/TRAVELLING/AT_SPOT/RETURNING_HOME)
authorities.notes: World advances time and knowledge only; fishing itself belongs to FishingEngine. TripSummary is derived for the return-home view.

authorities.title: Environment resolution (weather/tide/conditions)
authorities.persisted: derived from world time/season — not stored as authority
authorities.notes: Environment is derived from world state; persist inputs (time/location), not resolved conditions.

authorities.title: Fish box / buyers / contacts / freshness
authorities.notes: Freshness is a derived decay over world time. Contacts/buyers share one id space (ContactId).

authorities.title: Expedition / region visits / permits
authorities.notes: Independent block since v7. Home region differs from current region while on expedition.

authorities.title: Save schema + migrations
authorities.notes: CURRENT_SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION=9. Breaking change => bump version + add migration. Migration is pure/deterministic, never throws; unknown future versions are rejected, not guessed. Coordinator never writes before hydration completes.

authorities.title: Content loading / schema / catalog / packs
authorities.persisted: content files are the authority; generated index is derived
authorities.notes: Store/UI must not read content dir directly — they receive validated definitions. Generated content-index.json must be regenerated when data changes (doctor checks freshness).

authorities.title: Runtime stores and persistence boundary
authorities.notes: Store holds no domain rules and does not load content. PersistedPlayerSlice is the save boundary — anything persisted must round-trip through CurrentSave.

authorities.title: Screens and presentation
authorities.notes: UI renders state and sends commands only. Exception noted under actual-landed-zone (a resolver currently lives in ui/fishing).
